stage_rules.rule: Numerical and theoretical branches require qualified digital inputs, not physical fabrication, calibration or scans; a blocked printer does not block numeric evidence review
Source-table geometry and reoptimized geometry are alternative declared inputs. Never force GA completion when the selected route is source-table geometry; never call source dimensions original CAD
Each printed part needs its own stock/build/safe-release/extraction/inspection chain. All nine distinct accepted sections precede panel qualification
A complete valid blank_reflection scan precedes PANEL_INSTALL and sample_reflection acquisition; installed panel RUN_CHECK precedes sample_transmission and sample_reflection scans
For each configuration and point, a current pose/settle event precedes four distinct valid raw acquisitions; scan closure requires exactly the declared point set and complete repeats

Blank and sample reflection must share guide/source/DAQ/microphone/medium/grid/phase/frame signatures. Moving the frame or drifting source invalidates their pairing and triggers a new blank/sample pair

Panel removal/reinstallation increments install epoch; assembly changes increment assembly version. Raw data retain earlier identity; unqualified replacement cannot inherit calibration or run validity
ORDER_ANALYSIS remains provisional until DRIFT_POST is valid. A failed closing check invalidates the pair, regardless of favorable field shape

ARCHIVE requires every selected occurrence terminal and custody/cleanup for used stations. Fabrication requires print job-terminal and thermal/motion/guard-safe receipts; guide work requires SAFE_OFF; only field-measurement campaigns require post-run drift. Preparation does not require guide access.
Every repeated operation carries episode, branch, configuration, run, object revision, point/restart/iteration and unique occurrence IDs. Empty or null schedules block completion

CLEAN_RESET binds only affected stations. Fabrication-only episodes use PRINT_RUN thermal/motion/guard safe-release evidence. Any guide episode requires SAFE_OFF before guide cleanup. No guide access is needed for fabrication-only completion.
